blocks.text: Collaboration pools knowledge and skills to solve complex problems, and iteration refines work with each step. In community clean-up drives in Pakistan, people plan where to start, then adjust their plans when tasks take longer or more volunteers are needed (iterate), and keep working together (collaborate) until the area is clean. The book adds that the Indus Valley Civilization showed early collaboration and iteration in its town planning and construction (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: How do collaboration and iteration contribute to a new venture's success? Give examples (long question 8).
blocks.explanation: Collaboration brings partners with different skills, a baker and a business manager writing one plan together, so work is shared and ideas improve. Iteration launches a simple version, gathers customer feedback and improves it repeatedly, like a juice shop adjusting its menu after the first month's sales, so the product fits the market better and mistakes stay small. Together they reduce risk and keep the business adapting.

items: Together, collaboration and iteration give better results and lower risk (clean-up drives).
